authority: Current human asks real-support controls without real outcomes
baseline: Synthetic maximum-ignorance opener probabilities1/13 each and ending-group probabilities1/4 each. No real class prevalence is read or estimated. Qualification, if any, is restricted to this declared synthetic frequency profile at real support.

generator.independent: Independent multinomial counts in every readable noninitial slot, line labels fixed.
generator.wrap: Opener log-weight slopes linspace(-log2,+log2,13) and ending slopes linspace(-log1.5,+log1.5,4), multiplied by short indicator. Normalize probability vectors. Label/wrap relationship is actual fixed geometry.
generator.position: Same slopes multiplied by (2*original noninitial word-slot fraction-1)+(2*original registered-block line fraction-1). Unknown slots retain positions and receive no draws.
generator.folio_latent: One shared standard-Normal z per physical folio/trial; opener and ending slopes multiplied by z/1.959963984540054, constant within folio. H/F share latent z but draw separate synthetic counts.
generator.positive: qok probability exactly1.5/13 in FG/VE,1/13 otherwise; other12 opener probabilities share remaining mass uniformly. Endings unchanged.

seeds.derivation: SHA256 colon-joined base,scenario,reading,trial; first8bytes big-endian; no tuning

permutation_bank: One fixed10000-draw unrestricted within-folio label bank per reading, shared across independent synthetic datasets; exactly match frozen shuffle order. Report dependence conditional on fixed bank; H/F not independent replication.

decisions.primary: p<.05 only if unchanged engine estimable; no strata => NOT ESTIMABLE, never zero false-positive validation.
decisions.scan: Full17 class counts, binary generalized-CMH quadratic perclass; unchanged support, all10000 label permutations or exact support-failure proof; Holm17 withinreading.
decisions.null: >=200 independent datasets. Upper Wilson95 false-family-flag rate<=.05 AND complete estimability required for qualification; conditional defined-subset diagnostics never rescue it.
decisions.positive: Unconditional detection>=.80 over all200 datasets for primary and qok Holm scan. Undefined results count as no detection and remain separately labelled.
decisions.equivalence: All15 pair design gates already fail at real support; do not run unsupported bootstrap or declare invariance.

execution: NumPy/sparse exact algebra may precompute geometry and check support before statistics. Compare reference frozen engine on engineering fixtures and observed/failed-draw boundaries. No threshold, stratum, shuffle restriction or undefined-draw deletion changes.
real_outcomes: NEVER READ/GENERATED; only synthetic counts joined with labels
